title: Envirocast® Wall System: Two-Story Residential Build in Gainesville, FL
summary: CXT® Inc., a subsidiary of L.B. Foster, used the Envirocast Wall System to accelerate construction of a dual-unit residential investment property near Florida State University in Gainesville, Florida.
body_markdown:
A[Florida](https://lbfoster.com/infrastructure/precast-concrete-products/envirocast-wall-system/envirocast-wall-system-florida) property owner and investor needed a construction solution that would reduce jobsite complexity, limit neighborhood disruption, and accelerate the project timeline so the unit could enter the short-term rental market as soon as possible. The[Envirocast](https://lbfoster.com/infrastructure/precast-concrete-products/envirocast-wall-system) wall system streamlined construction, enabling the owner to begin finishing stages in less than two weeks, helping the property reach the rental market sooner and generate income much faster than traditional construction.
